- The modification in `xen_smp_cpus_done()` ensures that the calculation is performed for PV domains, addressing the kernel panic issue that occurred when this calculation was only done for HVM domains. if (xen_hvm_domain())
    native_smp_cpus_done(max_cpus);
```

else

```
